# Findings the CodeQL gate in .github/workflows/codeql.yml must not fail the build on.
#
# A gate with no escape hatch does not survive its first false positive — it gets commented out, and
# then nothing is scanning at all. This file is the hatch, deliberately narrow: one line per accepted
# finding, with the reason in the open where a reviewer sees it in the diff.
#
# Format:  <rule-id> <path-prefix> # why
# Matching is by rule id AND path prefix, so an exemption granted to one file does not silently cover
# the next occurrence somewhere else. Entries stop applying if the code moves.
#
# Suppressed alerts still appear in the Security tab. This only decides what blocks a merge.
#
# Before adding a line here, be sure the finding is wrong rather than inconvenient. "We know about it"
# is not a reason; "the query's assumption does not hold, and here is why" is.

java/weak-cryptographic-algorithm src/main/java/net/jojoaddison/consultancy/security/BreachedPasswordChecker.java # SHA-1 is the HIBP range API's lookup key, not a credential hash; password storage is bcrypt and untouched. See the class javadoc.
